1	# Brief: council agendas in plain language
2	
3	Commonread turns city council agendas into short plain-language summaries and alerts residents when their street or topic comes up.
4	It's a small nonprofit project and must read as neutral, never taking sides on council decisions.
5	A model drafts each summary and a volunteer checks it, and residents should be able to open the original agenda item.
6	Residents are who we serve, but city clerks and local funders will also judge the page.
7	The main action is signing up for one neighbourhood's alerts, and there's no backend for that yet.

# Render a page at 1440x900, 768x1024 and 390x844. Every backend writes the same files:
# <width>-top.png (first screen) and <width>.png (full page).

set -uo pipefail
if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then echo "usage: render.sh <url-or-file> <out-dir>" >&2; exit 2; fi
target="$1"
output="$2"
mkdir -p "$output"
if [[ -f "$target" ]]; then target="file://$(cd "$(dirname "$target")" && pwd)/$(basename "$target")"; fi
node "$(dirname "$0")/render-playwright.mjs" "$target" "$output"
